title: Physiognomicical

inlines.v: PHYSIOGNOM'IC'ICAL, adjective s as z. [See Physiognomy.] Pertaining to physiognomy; expressing the temper, disposition or other qualities of the mind by signs in the countenance; or drawing a knowledge of the state of the mind from the features of the face.
